evidence: Film thicknesses were measured by variable angle spectroscopic ellipsometry using a J.A. Woollam M2000 system. X-ray reflectivity (XRR) measurements were carried out (X’Pert Pro, PANalytical) to confirm the film thickness and obtain further insight into the role of the film density on WER. High-resolution transmission electron microscopy (HRTEM) at an acceleration voltage of 300 kV was employed to confirm the structure and morphology of the films. The composition analysis was conducted by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS, PHI VersaProbe Scanning XPS Microscope)
